The Idaho knowledge test

  • 40 multiple-choice questions.
  • You need 34 correct answers to pass (85%).
  • The state also gives the test in Spanish.

Practice questions

150 practice questions for Idaho: 21 about Idaho rules and 129 about signs, signals and markings that are the same in every state. Free: every question, hints and read-aloud. No sign-up.

Languages

  • Every question: English, Español.
  • The 129 national questions (signs, signals, road markings) also in 中文, Tiếng Việt, Tagalog, العربية. In these languages the Idaho questions show in English for now.

5 sample questions

1. In Idaho, how many questions are on the written knowledge test?

  1. 20 questions
  2. 25 questions
  3. 40 questions (correct answer)
  4. 50 questions

Answer: C. The Idaho knowledge test has 40 questions, all taken from the driver's handbook.

Idaho handbook, page 32.

2. In Idaho, who must wear a seat belt while a teen drives with a supervised instruction permit?

  1. Only the driver
  2. Only people in the front seat
  3. Only children
  4. Everyone in the vehicle (correct answer)

Answer: D. While an Idaho teen drives on a supervised instruction permit, everyone in the vehicle must wear a seat belt.

Idaho handbook, page 19.

3. In Idaho, which stopped vehicle with flashing lights is covered by the Move Over law?

  1. Only police cars
  2. Only ambulances
  3. Only fire trucks
  4. Tow trucks and highway incident response vehicles too (correct answer)

Answer: D. Idaho's Move Over law covers police and emergency vehicles, and since 2019 also tow trucks and highway incident response vehicles.

Idaho handbook, page 95.

4. In Idaho, how many questions can you miss on the knowledge test and still pass?

  1. Up to 6 (correct answer)
  2. Up to 2
  3. Up to 10
  4. Up to 12

Answer: A. On the Idaho knowledge test you can miss up to 6 of the 40 questions, so you need 34 right answers to pass.

Idaho handbook, page 32.

5. In Idaho, how long must a teen hold the supervised instruction permit, at a minimum?

  1. 3 months
  2. 6 months (correct answer)
  3. 9 months
  4. 12 months

Answer: B. An Idaho teen must hold the supervised instruction permit for at least six months without any violation.

Idaho handbook, page 19.
